remaining_minor includes any held_minor. Active source reservations reduce spendability separately.

Quotes reserve no money. An executed payment consumes its actual source allocations immediately, even though settlement occurs later.

Aggregate account balances cannot override a source restriction. Source classifications survive transfers; the source_goods review is the specified way to correct a supported classification rather than wash provenance through another account.
